name: Dixon of Dock Green
description: Dixon of Dock Green was a BBC television series following the activities of police officers at a fictional Metropolitan Police station in the East End of London from 1955 to 1976. Some episodes were later remade as a BBC radio series in 2005 and 2006.

videos.title: The Roaring Boy
videos.overview: On the trail of a young deserter from the army, Dixon finds himself trapped in a perilous situation.

videos.overview: A badly beaten man is pulled from the river and manages to say just one word before dying: "Molenzicht". This proves to be the catalyst for Dock Green's CID to team up with their counterparts in Rotterdam to try and identify the murderer.

videos.overview: Harry Simpson is back from Spain. The same, genial Harry whom everybody thinks is wonderful. Everybody except for Detective Sergeant Andy Crawford, that is. But has Andy overstepped the mark in trying to prove his theory?

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Tom Adams is the guest star playing Jack Montelbetti, a jewel thief and diamond smuggler, who has been featured in earlier stories. On the day he is released from prison, Jack returns to his flat to discover the dead body of Bruno Pacelli, the father of his ex-fiancee.
